narrative: Germany GP tripled to GBP 78.4M after the acquisitions, but cost synergies are GBP 2.1M behind plan YTD (GBP 2.4M delivered vs GBP 4.5M phased). Revenue synergies are ahead (GBP 1.8M vs GBP 1.5M). The onboarding template makes the next acquisition a 10-day consolidation.

signals.title: Germany synergy tracker — cost synergies behind plan
signals.excerpt: £2.4M of cost synergies delivered YTD against £4.5M phased; two of five platform migrations slipped to Q1 2027; revenue synergies ahead (£1.8M vs £1.5M).
